name: The penthouse (a showcase for the testers, not a level of the game)
about: Javier & Claude, 2026-11-04. Level 8's boss from the team's roster, Velvet Rook: the Enforcer's three cuts, faster, then Checkmate: his Enforcers come in through the doors, one for each door switch still standing (smash them); he parries the plain combos (P P P, K K K), only the mixed ones get through; three perfect blocks on his last cut break his sword, and he's only fists, slow and old. Not in levels.json.
